title: Evaluating Judges as Evaluators: The JETTS Benchmark of LLM-as-Judges as Test-Time Scaling Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Employing a consistency-based pairwise evaluation setup where each comparison is run twice with the order of responses swapped to detect and mitigate order preference.
Evaluating judge performance by comparing standard non-length-controlled win rates against length-controlled win rates on the AlpacaEval dataset to assess improper preference for longer responses.

Qualitatively analyzing over 100 critique-response pairs to identify instances where judge models over-emphasize surface-level stylistic details (e.g., ease of reading, formatting, or response length) rather than evaluating actual logical correctness.
